name: BSS Customer Feedback Hub for WooCommerce
author: BangladeshSoftwareSolution

sections.description:
BSS Customer Feedback Hub for WooCommerce replaces the basic WooCommerce review box with a rich, modern “Customer Feedback” section — star reviews, community questions & answers, photo & video uploads, helpful voting, verified-owner badges and full moderation — all in one lightweight, dependency-free plugin.

It looks great on any theme out of the box. The palette automatically follows your active theme (light or dark), and you can set a single accent colour to match your brand — no page builder, no jQuery and no third-party libraries required.

Why store owners choose it

  • One section for reviews, questions, photos, videos and comments — far more than plain star ratings.
  • Builds buyer trust with “verified owner” badges and public helpful-vote counts.
  • Keeps your product star averages accurate — reviews use WooCommerce’s native review type.
  • Fast and self-contained — vanilla JavaScript, scoped styles, assets loaded only where needed.
  • Fully translatable and RTL-ready out of the box.

Contribution types

  • Reviews with star ratings
  • Questions & answers (community Q&A, answer inline)
  • Photo uploads
  • Video uploads
  • Comments

Front-end experience

  • Big average score, a fractional star widget and a clickable rating histogram
  • Per-type filter pills, a sort dropdown and a “with media” toggle
  • Photo & video galleries with a full-screen lightbox
  • “Was this helpful?” voting with self-vote protection
  • Report / flag inappropriate contributions
  • Inline submission form with type tabs, an interactive star picker, a live word counter, drag-and-drop media previews and honeypot spam protection
  • Guest submissions with name/email, or automatic details for logged-in users
  • Live AJAX updates — new reviews, answers, counts and the histogram refresh without a page reload
  • Self-contained confirmation modal for submit, validation and voting messages — no dependency on the theme or other plugins

Moderation & management

  • Optional manual moderation, with auto-approval for administrators
  • Dedicated moderation screen with status tabs (All / Approved / Pending / Spam / Trash), a type filter and bulk actions (approve, unapprove, spam, move to trash; permanent delete from Trash/Spam)
  • Helpful / not-helpful and flag “signals” shown at a glance for every contribution
  • “Verified owner” badge and an option to accept reviews only from verified buyers
  • Choose whether a purchase counts after any paid order or only completed orders, or require only a registered account
  • Flagged-contribution handling (set to pending, spam, or record only) with a configurable flag threshold
  • Admin badges for chosen roles or usernames
  • Minimum / maximum word count and configurable media limits (files per contribution and max file size)

Appearance & compatibility

  • Theme-aware palette: text and surfaces follow the active theme (light or dark)
  • Accent colour follows an admin colour-picker setting, the block theme’s primary colour, or a tasteful default — with automatically readable button text on any accent
  • Render inside the product “Reviews” tab (following your theme’s tab style) or as a full-width section below the product, or place it anywhere with the [bsscufeh_reviews] shortcode
  • RTL-ready — ships a mirrored stylesheet loaded automatically on right-to-left locales
  • HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) compatible

Developer friendly

  • Standard WordPress comments storage; reviews use the native WooCommerce review type so star aggregates stay in sync
  • Fully translatable (text domain bss-customer-feedback-hub-for-woocommerce, includes a .pot)
  • Scoped, prefixed CSS with overridable --bssr-* variables; no theme or third-party plugin dependency
  • Filters such as bsscufeh_contribution_types, bsscufeh_section_heading, bsscufeh_submittable_types and bsscufeh_verified_statuses

Privacy

Contributions are stored as native WordPress comments. When a visitor submits a review, question, answer, photo, video or comment, the plugin stores the name and email address they enter (or their account details when logged in) and the submitter’s IP address — the same data WordPress records for any comment — to attribute the contribution, verify ownership and de-duplicate helpful votes. The plugin does not send any data to external services and does not track visitors.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the bss-customer-feedback-hub-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/ (or install the zip via Plugins → Add New → Upload).
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Configure options under Reviews → Settings.
  5. Moderate submissions under Reviews → Contributions.
sections.faq:
Does it require WooCommerce?

Yes. BSS Customer Feedback Hub for WooCommerce extends WooCommerce products and stays inactive until WooCommerce is active.

Where does the review section appear?

Inside the product “Reviews” tab (following your theme’s tab style) or as a full-width section below the product — set it under Reviews → Settings → Display position. You can also place it anywhere with the [bsscufeh_reviews] shortcode.

Can customers upload photos and videos?

Yes. Enable the Photo and Video contribution types, and customers can drag and drop attachments on the submission form (you control how many files and the maximum file size). Media appears in a gallery with a full-screen lightbox.

Can guests leave reviews?

Yes, unless you restrict reviews to verified owners. When restricted, guests can still submit and their purchase is verified by the email address from their order.

Can I accept reviews only from verified buyers?

Yes. Turn on “Reviews can only be left by verified owners” and choose whether a purchase counts after any paid order, only after completion, or simply requires a registered account.

Can I moderate and bulk-manage contributions?

Yes. The Contributions screen has status tabs, a type filter and bulk actions — approve, unapprove, mark as spam or move to trash in one click (permanent delete is available from the Trash and Spam views).

Does it change my product star ratings?

No — it keeps them accurate. Rating-bearing contributions use WooCommerce’s native review comment type, so your product star average and shop-loop ratings stay in sync automatically.

Can I change the colours?

Yes. The section uses a theme-aware palette out of the box, and you can set an exact Accent colour under Reviews → Settings. For finer control, your theme can override the scoped --bssr-* CSS variables.

Will it slow down my site?

No. The plugin uses plain (vanilla) JavaScript with no jQuery dependency, ships scoped styles, and loads its assets only on product pages and pages using the shortcode.

Is it translatable and RTL-ready?

Yes. A .pot template ships in /languages — translate it with Loco Translate or any gettext tool. A mirrored right-to-left stylesheet is loaded automatically on RTL locales.

Is it compatible with HPOS?

Yes. The plugin declares compatibility with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage.
